== Summary ==
Only surviving copy (thumbnail, 50×38). Decipher's caption: "Ian Vincent of the UK placed 7th in his first Star Trek CCG World Championships." Photo: Decipher. See [[DecipherCon 1999]] and [[DecipherCon 1999 photographs]].
